scope.discoveryRestriction: only committed files in ecosystem/proposals; no generated or inferred authorization

preconditions: repo still exists, is public and owner unchanged
live default branch still equals pinned named branch
live default branch SHA equals exact proof base SHA
target file still absent at pinned SHA
GitHub check-runs and commit statuses both accessible and not truncated
no failing, unresolved or absent CI evidence
default branch SHA unchanged after evidence retrieval

outputs.meaning: actual CI evidence is for base commit only, NOT unexecuted proposal content

workflow.automatic: scan at most 8 real JSON proof envelopes committed under ecosystem/proposals; no proof gives HOLD_NO_PROPOSALS
workflow.manual: optional exact proposal path under ecosystem/proposals
